ToD_A02_CNMC2_VO_S003_003.source_old: The trolls were penned and chained.The humans were careless… assuming that the only threat in the forest was the one that they had already captured. No one who saw us at Durnholde survived.

ToD_A02_CNMC2_VO_S003_004.source_old: Your warriors saved us. We fought side by side at Southshore and Hillsbrad. It is an honor for da trolls to be in your Horde.
